name: ci_cd_orchestration
description: Generates CI/CD pipeline configurations (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.) from the deployment plan and project requirements. Maps each build/deploy step to the CI platform's format.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: CI platform: github_actions | gitlab_ci | jenkins | custom

outputs.name: pipeline_config
outputs.description: { platform, files: [{path, content}], triggers: string[], secrets_required: string[] }

side_effects: Writes pipeline config files to the project root

error_codes.recovery: List supported platforms; do not generate an unsupported format (Law 12).
